set.body: Acceptance: a small pure tracker-to-stimulus synchronization API fits offset-only or centered affine maps from at least two named common markers; the successful value records source and target ClockId, slope, offset, residuals, maximum absolute residual, rejected markers, and uncertainty; insufficient, duplicated, nonfinite, or nonmonotonic evidence is a sealed named failure; applying the fit is total for finite tracker timestamps; hand-computable offset/drift fixtures and slope/offset mutants run identically on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Golden workflow: fit auditable tracker/stimulus synchronization evidence
